snippet.title: Little Farm Island: Play on Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Farm, explore, and survive! 🌿 Little Farm Island blends cozy life with thrilling adventure. Build your dream farm, furnish your home, and uncover hidden island mysteries. Manage resources, take on exciting quests, and survive in a world full of secrets. Every day is a new adventure.  are you ready?

Buy it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555600/Little_Farm_Island/?l=english
